{{Quote|What iz it?''"<br />"''It's Mobus. We've fallen into its shadow.''"<br />"''We call it Sanctuary.|[[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Soron Hegerty]] and [[Rowel]]|<ref name="Reunion" />}}
'''Mobus''', sometimes referred to as '''Sanctuary''', and also known as '''Klasse A''' in the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] surveys, was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Klasse Ephemora system/Legends|Klasse Ephemora system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Klasse Ephemora (star)|Klasse Ephemora]].

==History==
{{Quote|System captures are scarce enough as it is, but the acquisition of extra-solar world-sized moons by gas giants would be extremely rare. I'd be amazed to find even one in the last hundred years. The odds of it happening in a system's habitable zone are minute.|[[Danni Quee]]|<ref name="Refugee" />}}
Mobus had 17 [[Moon/Legends|moons]],<ref name="Refugee" /> including [[M-Three]].<ref name="Reunion" /> It was also [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the living [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]].<ref name="Reunion" /> It had a gem mining station established over it that was abandoned around [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], due to [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] storms.<ref name="Refugee" />
